source.author: Anastasia Kireeva
source.title: Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdős–Rényi graph (problems 36-38)

metric.name: E_framework
metric.movement: NO FROZEN-METRIC MOVEMENT; source-generalization obligation moved materially

method_outcomes.B3: PROGRESS: replaced negative association by a general Laplace-domination theorem. If log E exp(<h,S>) <= sum_i r_i psi_i(h_i), then for iid latent replicas and H>=0, Psi_mu(H)<=sum_i r_i psi_i(b_i) with b_i=sum_j r_j H_ij psi_j(W_j)/W_j. Sequential conditional occupancy caps imply the sub-Poisson specialization and give a finite local certificate for dependent latent Gibbs supports.
method_outcomes.B23: PROGRESS VIA REFUTATION + REPAIR: an exact Boolean change-of-basis example has zero source LDA, O(1) collision pressure, perfect off-diagonal source-degree transport, and product log-Sobolev/hypercontractivity, yet fixed positive noisy TV because a high source-degree parity is a degree-one noise eigenfunction. Full statistical indistinguishability requires source-degree-aligned full-tail damping, under which a direct L2 argument gives a TV bound.
method_outcomes.B29: PROGRESS: for exchangeable latent supports with size LDP rate I, derived the hypergeometric intersection rate J and the variational collision free energy Lambda_I(c)=sup_{x,y,z}{cz-I(x)-I(y)-J(z;x,y)}. Calibrations recover iid Bernoulli, fixed-size, empty/full and exponentially rare macroscopic regimes. Lambda_I(c)>0 forces Theta(n) pressure and rules out source-scale Pi_2=o(D_n).

mathematical_state.laplace_collision_theorem: If log E_mu exp(<h,S>)<=sum_i r_i psi_i(h_i) for all h>=0, W_j=sum_i H_ij, kappa_j=psi_j(W_j)/W_j and b_i=sum_j r_j kappa_j H_ij, then log E exp(S^THT)<=sum_i r_i psi_i(b_i).
mathematical_state.sub_poisson_certificate: Prefix conditional occupancy P(S_i=1|S_1,...,S_{i-1})<=pbar_i implies log E exp(<h,S>)<=sum_i pbar_i(e^{h_i}-1). Uniform full-boundary conditional caps imply prefix caps by tower property. Pairwise latent Gibbs laws admit pbar_i=logistic(theta_i+sum_{j:J_ij>0}J_ij).
mathematical_state.tv_obstruction: On uniform Boolean Q, conjugate product noise by an invertible F2 character map so a source-degree m>D parity becomes a degree-one noise coordinate. Then L=1+a chi_R has Adv^{<=D}=0 and Pi_2=log(1+a^2), while TV after fixed time t is a e^{-t}/2 despite perfect off-diagonal source-degree transport and product LSI/hypercontractivity.
mathematical_state.tv_repair: If ||S_t Pi_{>D}||_{2->2}<=exp(-kappa_t(D+1)), then TV(P S_t,Q)<=0.5 Adv^{<=D}(P,Q)+0.5 exp(Pi_2/2-kappa_t(D+1)). Thus vanishing LDA plus Pi_2=o(D) and fixed positive kappa_t imply noisy TV convergence.
mathematical_state.exchangeable_ldp: If |S|/n obeys an LDP with rate I, then conditional intersection fraction z given sizes x,y has J(z;x,y)=h(y)-x h(z/x)-(1-x)h((y-z)/(1-x)); for K_c=exp(c|S cap T|), n^{-1}log E K_c -> sup{cz-I(x)-I(y)-J(z;x,y)}.
mathematical_state.macroscopic_obstruction: At D_n=o(n), positive collision free energy Lambda_I(c)>0 forces Pi_2=Theta(n), so any source-scale pressure framework allowing exchangeable rare macroscopic supports must at least satisfy Lambda_I(c)=0; moderate-deviation control is still needed for Pi_2=o(D_n).

prior_art_state: Sub-Poisson/product Laplace bounds, stochastic domination from conditional intensity caps, negative association/strong-Rayleigh examples, Gibbs/Donsker-Varadhan variational formulas, Boolean Fourier product-noise LSI/hypercontractivity, Dobrushin/KP/complete-analyticity locality, Renyi/collision entropy, Cramer/Sanov/Varadhan large deviations, hypergeometric entropy asymptotics, Kato/Toda/QR and Davies/Combes-Thomas are classical. Source-directed synthesis novelty remains UNVERIFIED.
later_negative_stress: Songtao Mao arXiv:2607.20318 remains mandatory and is excluded only through substantive pressure/reference, latent-regularity and degree/noise-alignment hypotheses, never by naming the rank distinguisher.

next_attack.B12: Identify the exact source-degree/noise-energy alignment invariant that excludes the parity-basis counterexample; formulate it as a spectral/form lower bound on high source layers and compare it with the existing Kato/Toda tilted certificate.
next_attack.B20: Attempt to upgrade weak-Ising Kato/Toda leakage control to full high-source-degree damping; if impossible, isolate the exact slow mode or missing coercivity hypothesis rather than adding another leakage lemma.
next_attack.B27: State and test a sharp two-tier quantifier framework: bounded LDA gives pressure-controlled polynomial indistinguishability, while vanishing LDA plus aligned full-tail damping gives TV; reconcile explicitly against Hsieh and Chen-Li.
